description: This file defines the RedisGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface for managing gateway lists in a Redis-based Orleans clustering setup. It includes methods to retrieve the list of active gateways and initialize the provider.

classes.name: RedisGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to supply gateway URIs from a Redis-backed membership table.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of active gateway URIs from the Redis membership table.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the Redis membership table for the gateway list provider.
